subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Musical composition is primarily the craft of creating original works of music.
• Antoine Foster was an American jazz composer born in 1912.
• He is known for his compositions for big band ensembles.
• Choreography is primarily the art of designing sequences of movement for dance.
• Idris Sithole was a South African choreographer born in 1925.
• He is known for his choreography based on traditional Zulu dance.
prompt: Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to emphasize a similarity between Foster and Sithole?

choices.A: Antoine Foster created compositions for big band ensembles; Idris Sithole, by contrast, is known for his choreography based on traditional Zulu dance.
choices.B: Musical composition and choreography are just two examples of the many artistic disciplines in which creators can specialize.
choices.C: Like jazz composer Antoine Foster, choreographer Idris Sithole dedicated his artistic career to a performing art form.
choices.D: The jazz composer Antoine Foster was born in 1912, but choreographer Idris Sithole was born later, in 1925.

explanation:
Choice C is the best answer. The sentence emphasizes a similarity between Foster and Sithole, noting that both artists dedicated their careers to a performing art form—Foster through his jazz compositions for big band ensembles and Sithole through his choreography based on traditional Zulu dance.

Why A is incorrect:

Choice A is incorrect. The sentence emphasizes a difference between Foster and Sithole, using the phrase 'by contrast' to signal that their work focused on different art forms; it doesn't emphasize a similarity between them.
